extracted.name: Hot Carob
extracted.description: In this hot carob recipe, carob is lightly sweetened with honey and vanilla extract for this satisfying alternative to hot chocolate on chilly evenings.
instruction_lines: Combine milk and carob powder in a small saucepan over medium heat, whisking to remove any lumps. Stir in honey and vanilla extract; heat until reaches desired temperature.
